properties.statement:
⚠️ THIS NODE OPENED WITH A FALSE CLAIM ABOUT REFLOW2'S OWN HISTORY AND IS CORRECTED HERE. It said the eight subsystems were "drawn afterwards as containers" and that reflow2 has no functional layer. BOTH ARE WRONG, and `dec:bl83a-functional-decomposition` — ACCEPTED, 2026-07-23, DERIVED WITH THE USER — was in the graph the whole time saying so.

WHAT THAT DECISION ACTUALLY RECORDS: "reflow2's own decomposition IS the functional systems a design-graph tool IS — vocabulary, store, coherence-loop, human-channel, time-history, intake, agent-surface [+documentation] — with the 38 Rust modules RE-PARENTED UNDER THEM as implementation. The as-built crate grouping (reflow2-core / -mcp / kit) is RETIRED from the as-designed view." And its rationale states the principle outright: "A functional carving comes from the product's PURPOSE (a genesis input), not the code, and cuts across crate boundaries, so adopt on the code can only re-derive the module view." ⇒ THE FUNCTIONAL DECOMPOSITION WAS DONE, DELIBERATELY, FIRST, AND WITH THE USER. The eight boxes are the functional layer. The file tree is what they REPLACED.

⭐ HOW THE ERROR HAPPENED, because it is the session's own recurring lesson landing on its author: I MEASURED THE EDGES AND INFERRED THE HISTORY, without reading the Decision that recorded the history. Three times in one day a stale or unread document sent this session down a wrong path; this is the fourth, and the unread thing was the design's own governing decision. A graph that holds WHY is only worth having if the why is read before the shape is interpreted.

── WHAT SURVIVES THE CORRECTION, all still measured and still true ──
56 Components: 8 at `level: subsystem`, 48 at `level: component`, `CONTAINS` over 42 of the 48.
• Of 178 `ALLOCATED_TO` edges, 177 point at a MODULE and ONE at a subsystem; `DECOMPOSES` is ZERO. So per-subsystem function counts (65 / 40 / 20 / 15 / 7 / 6 / 4 / 3 for coherence-loop, agent-surface, time-history, store, intake, vocabulary, human-channel, documentation) are computed by walking `CONTAINS` and are recorded nowhere. THAT IS STILL A REAL GAP — but it is an ALLOCATION-RECORDING gap, not the absence of a functional layer.
• Six components sit in no subsystem (`degraded`, `identity`, `nudge`, `packaging`, `registry`, `sync`); two capabilities are allocated to nothing (`cap:capture-session-skill`, `cap:update-is-one-word`).

THE DECOMPOSITION IS COHESIVE. Treating Store and Vocabulary as foundation layers — everything may legitimately use the store and the type system — coupling splits 50 to/from foundation, 17 INSIDE a peer subsystem, and only SIX CROSSING peer subsystems. ⚠️ THAT FOUNDATION JUDGEMENT IS MINE, NOT THE GRAPH'S: counting their use as violations instead gives 51 crossings against 22 and reads as a hairball. Nothing in the design declares a layer.

NO GOD NODES. Capability load per module: median 3, max 16 (`cmp:skills`), top 12 of 48 carrying 57%. The two hubs — `cmp:nodes` (six subsystems) and `cmp:graph` (five) — sit in the foundation subsystems, where being a hub is correct.

⭐⭐ THE FINDING THAT SURVIVES INTACT AND IS THE REAL ONE: 73 COUPLED MODULE PAIRS, ZERO SHARING A DECLARED INTERFACE, 51 CROSSING A SUBSYSTEM BOUNDARY. All 15 Interfaces sit at the SYSTEM edge; NONE describes an internal boundary between two of the eight functional systems. Measured on the swap test Anthony proposed: `cmp:detect` has 13 functions and 2 dependents and provides ZERO declared interfaces; `cmp:heal` 4 and 1 and ZERO; `cmp:search` 1 and 0 and ZERO. There is nothing to swap AGAINST. ⇒ THE BOXES ARE REAL AND FUNCTIONALLY DERIVED; WHAT THEY LACK IS CONTRACTS. `undeclared_seam` has been reporting exactly this as one aggregate gap at severity 0.45, under the 0.8 gate.

RECOMMENDED, unchanged by the correction and strengthened by it: do NOT re-derive the functional decomposition — it exists, it is accepted, and it is sound. DO declare the internal seams. That is the whole distance between eight functional systems and eight black boxes.

NOT ESTABLISHED: how many distinct CONTRACTS the 51 crossing pairs collapse into — the figure counts PAIRS and the real number is likely far smaller.
